state_of_play: Repository bootstrapped and the product framework is committed. No application code yet: the stack decision (ADR-0001) is open and blocks the first vertical slice.

phases.name: Calibration pilot
phases.goal: Calibrate items, formats and reading levels. Not sales.
phases.scope: Pilot build: M1 subset (~60 cards, ~10 videos), M2 calibration item set, M3-lite, M6 telemetry. Three deliberately different sites: a Tashkent private school, a viloyat-centre school, a rural school. Target n = 150-300 students, grades 7-9.

exit_criteria.label: Session completion across all three sites
Median unique career cards viewed per student
Parent join rate in at least one site
Calibration items flagged for comprehension failure in either script
Item pool surviving statistical screening into the v1 scored set

phases.name: MVP, B2C via Telegram (free)
phases.goal: Accumulate psychometric data, norms and word of mouth; the family module is the retention engine.
phases.scope: Telegram Mini App plus responsive web/PWA at account parity; three locales at full parity; M1 at content floor; M2 full item set with v1 scoring; M3 full; M4 template planner; M6 pipelines; consent, residency and audit logging.

exit_criteria.label: Phase-1 metrics trending to target for one school term

phases.name: B2B, private schools first
phases.goal: The advisor's operating system and the reporting wedge. Districts for public scale after.
phases.scope: M5 full, M7 async Q&A, lab mode, onboarding kit, manual invoicing, advisor micro-training.

exit_criteria.label: Paying schools with renewed intent
exit_criteria.target: N - set in the Decisions Log at Phase-2 start

phases.name: Universities
phases.goal: First-year orientation, major-switching triage, employability. Not designed yet, by intent.

metrics.label: Activation: signups completing at least one assessment chunk
Exposure breadth: median unique cards viewed per 30 days
Full assessment completion among activated users
Parent join rate on invited families
D30 retention on any meaningful event
Generated advisor reports per class per term
School renewal intent at term end
Follow-up response rate at 6 months, via Telegram

phase-1.label: Telegram Mini App published; web/PWA live at parity; both scripts plus Russian verified in production
Privacy policy and consent flows live in uz and ru; data-residency verification documented; deletion flow tested end to end
Content floor met within freshness rules
Support channel live; crash and analytics dashboards on; rollback plan rehearsed
Brand register check: local, practical, slightly commercial - not an NGO intervention

phase-2.label: School onboarding kit: advisor micro-training, rostering guide, data-processing agreement, MOU template
Lab mode field-tested in at least two real school labs; report templates validated with at least two practising advisors
Pricing sheet approved; manual invoicing acceptable at start
Access matrix and E-3 non-features communicated to school leadership in writing during onboarding

risks.label: Deterministic labeling
risks.mitigation: P-4, E-1, E-2 - plural provisional outputs are the only outputs that exist.

risks.label: Test-gaming
risks.mitigation: E-7 low-stakes framing, no visible scores, behavioral signals that are hard to fake.

risks.label: Being read as teaching children to defy parents
risks.mitigation: M3 overlap-first framing, parents' own values vocabulary, E-4 and E-6.

risks.label: Institutional misuse
risks.mitigation: E-3 as a product-level refusal plus written expectation-setting at onboarding.

risks.label: Content staleness
risks.mitigation: Freshness rules and publishing blocks; wage/cost data older than 6 months cannot publish.

risks.label: Transliteration credibility
risks.mitigation: Exception table as a tested artifact with a regression suite; human review of both scripts.

risks.label: Telegram platform dependency
risks.mitigation: Full web/PWA parity from MVP - the Mini App is a distribution choice, not the architecture.

risks.label: Regulatory drift
risks.mitigation: M5-F3 report templates are content-configurable; maintain contact with pilot advisors as early warning.

risks.label: Donor-project aesthetics
risks.mitigation: Brand register check in the launch checklist; pricing exists because paid things are taken seriously.

risks.label: Copying
risks.mitigation: The moat is the content library, exposure-conditioned data, local norms and the validation loop. Invest there first.
